text.tspan: One public IP, many inside hosts: outbound SNAT/PAT and inbound DNAT
same source port: port rewritten (the P in PAT)
port forward: only the destination changes
Before the DNAT rule (tested): curl http://203.0.113.1:8080/laptop.html → curl: (7) … Couldn't connect to server
Only a connection's first packet (the SYN) goes through the NAT rules: the DNAT counter shows 1 packet, 60 bytes.
conntrack translates every later packet, both ways. DNAT keeps the source: the laptop's app logged 203.0.113.50.
PAT limit: about 64,000 ports per public IP, for each destination IP, port and protocol.
